title: Ownership loss between blob publication and the commit changes nothing durable

fault.event: another backend claimed the project (explicit takeover after this process was killed)

steps.action: recheck ownership and revision under the mutation lock

durableEffects: possibly one unreferenced immutable blob from phase 3
observations: the revision is rechecked in the same lock acquisition, so a stale owner can never publish over newer work
the retry after takeover re-runs the publish; the blob publication is idempotent

notes: Concurrency rule: the mutation lock is held only for the authoritative phases, and ownership/revision are rechecked inside it.
